text: Insert Records API, key "trigger": "The trigger input can be workflow, approval, blueprint, pathfinder, or orchestration."
"If trigger is not mentioned, the automation actions related to the API will get executed."
"Enter the trigger value as [] to not execute the workflows."
Assignment rules are separate: "lar_id" is "the unique ID of the assignment rule you want to trigger while inserting a record".
